description: Veyra module layers, bottom to top (ADR-006 §3). A module may depend only on modules in lower layers: never on itself, on a module in its own layer, on a higher layer, or on any sealed layer. scripts/check_module_layers.py enforces this in CI. The milestone that creates a module adds it here; gameplay layers go between Foundation and Composition.

layers.name: Foundation
layers.description: Lowest Veyra-owned foundation. Depends on no other Veyra module.

layers.name: Rules
layers.description: Reusable gameplay rules with one authoritative owner each (PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md §2, Combat / Economy).

layers.name: Economy
layers.description: The Economy domain (ARCHITECTURE.md §3, ADR-008 §1): in-match Progression now, Gold later. Above Combat, whose verbs apply level-up growth; below Abilities, which reads ranks.

layers.name: Abilities
layers.description: Systems that compose the rules below them (PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md §2, Abilities).

layers.name: Items
layers.description: Items and the shop (ADR-012 §2, PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md "VeyraItems"): definitions, inventories and purchases. Above Abilities, whose archetypes run item Actives; below Battleground. Match routes the fountain and the player's requests to it.

layers.name: Battleground
layers.description: The battleground's systems (ADR-011 §2, PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md §2, Flux / World; Vision later): peers that compose Abilities' attacks and projectiles and meet only through Match (Orchestration). Above Abilities; below Content, whose kits may later call into the world.

layers.name: Content
layers.description: Content domains (ADR-008 §1, PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md "Vanguards"): definitions and the passives the shared systems cannot express. Above Abilities, whose archetypes run the kits; below Match, which orchestrates them.

layers.name: Orchestration
layers.description: Coordinates the systems below it without peer-to-peer dependencies (PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md §2, Match).

layers.name: Services
layers.description: The trusted-services client (ADR-006 §3, ADR-007 §12): the only modules that talk to the backend. They plug into the match's contracts, so no gameplay module knows HTTP.

layers.name: Presentation
layers.description: Presentation (ADR-008 §1, ARCHITECTURE.md §2): it observes every layer below and decides nothing, and nothing below knows it exists. Client only: its modules are ClientOnly in the .uproject, so servers neither build nor load them, and a module outside this layer may add one only for targets that are not servers.

layers.name: Composition
layers.description: The composition root. Sealed: nothing depends on it.

layers.name: Developer
layers.description: Automation tests and developer tooling. Sealed: production modules never depend on it.
